answer_1.quote: Fluency uses n-gram to monitor the fluency of the response generated by the edited LLM. Knowledge Question Answering (KQA) evaluates the success rate of knowledge question answering on TriviaQA. Content Summarization (CSum) evaluates the edited model's content summarization ability on Xsum, which is measured via ROUGE-1.
answer_1.outputs: Safe and unsafe model responses to adversarial queries
